topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I was tending to the garden, the same soil I've nurtured for years, when my spade hit something hard. It clinked just loudly enough to echo through the silence of the afternoon. I bent down, hands brushing aside the earth, revealing a metal box, corroded but unmistakably out of place. The courtyard has always been a sanctuary, but now it felt as if someone, or something, was watching. I hesitated before lifting the box, aware that the ground held secrets, and perhaps, not all were benign. The air seemed thicker, the shadows longer, as I contemplated what forgotten hands might have entrusted this earth with.
